parsed.explanation: The combined regime stacks a federal document/entry tier-1 exposure (X markers ended, M/F-only processing, discrepancy-driven refusal with possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, passports blocked and travelers stranded) onto a patchwork state layer: facility bans in roughly two-thirds of units, criminal trespass provisions in four, a division statutory ban on minor care with licence revocation, and contracted adult surgical capacity. Custody is documented hostile (conversion-therapy policy for federal inmates, abuse in immigration custody, a bathroom arrest held in a men's ward). Protections (federal hate-crime and employment law, active injunctions, legal-aid guidance) are real but do not reverse these operative practices. No identity criminalisation or execution pathway.

entry_documents.exposure: Jan 2025 order defines binary sex at conception/birth; X markers and non-birth-sex markers barred for new passports/visas (Feb 2025); Feb 2025 cable orders refusal where documents cast doubt on sex and weighs lifetime fraud ineligibility; travelers report passports confiscated/blocked, stranded abroad; 8+ foreign advisories issued.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X-marker passports valid until expiry; ACLU-type suit pending; legal-aid FAQ on documentation strategy.
entry_documents.interaction: One unit's 2026 law invalidating non-matching birth certificates/licences compounds federal entry screening by removing the document a traveler might otherwise present.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Federal corrections bureau adopted conversion-therapy-style policy (hair cut short, hormones removed, psychiatric substitution) for inmates from 2026; trans immigration detainees report forced labour, beatings, solitary, sexual abuse; a bathroom arrest resulted in 24 hours in a men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts formally available; federal hate-crime statute; several custody-related orders enjoined.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any state-level facility arrest (trespass charge) routes the visitor into custody where birth-sex placement and the federal inmate policy operate.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Facility bans by birth sex in 9+1 units (all government buildings incl. colleges), 9 units (schools plus some buildings), 3 units (schools only); 6 units extend to private settings; 4 units criminalise use in certain circumstances; one unit's 2026 law bars sex-segregated facility use broadly.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 units, 4 units and the capital district have no mapped ban; the trespass offence requires willful entry plus refusal to depart, not automatic arrest.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: The division's position within the map groups is not stated; wherever located, government-building bans apply to visitors using public buildings there.

care_services.exposure: Division statute (in force 1 July 2023) bars hormone therapy/surgery for under-18s with licence revocation; a coastal hospital cancelled all gender-affirming surgeries Feb 2025 including a pre-approved adult procedure, citing state and national law; national funding freezes and proposed public-insurance exclusion.
care_services.protection: Oct 2023 settlement obliges the public-employee plan to cover medically necessary care, including minors' out-of-state care.
care_services.interaction: An adult travelling with a minor faces care denial for the child: payment route exists but no lawful in-state provider; an adult's own surgery capacity contracted abruptly.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders label youth care 'mutilation' and direct law enforcement to investigate 'gender ideology' in schools; DOJ memo uses 'radical gender ideology' among violent-extremist viewpoints with a cash-reward system; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises neutralising groups 'radically pro-transgender'; advocates invoke early genocide stages.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: The strategy states counterterrorism powers will not target those who simply disagree; several orders blocked or enjoined; marriage and employment protections survive.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing lowers the threshold for police attention to an outed visitor and compounds document and facility exposures.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division minor-care ban with licence revocation; national order directing criminal investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating a trans minor's social transition; DOJ subpoena of under-19 hospital records; youth sports and school-facility restrictions; proposed under-18 insurance exclusion.
minors_guardians.protection: Plan settlement covers dependents' care incl. out-of-state treatment; litigation pending on several orders.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling guardian whose child is outed risks care denial, record scrutiny, and school/facility exclusion; the parent is not the defendant but the child's care is the constrained item.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Major-city police investigated three violent crimes against trans women in 2023, two fatal shootings a week apart, calling the pattern 'epidemic-level'; the division's recorded killing rate (4.8/100k) is an undercount floor with no usable denominator, so elevated trans-specific rate is unestablished.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal gender-identity hate-crime statute; 23 units cover gender identity in bias-violence statutes; investigations were opened.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Raw counts without a background denominator cannot show risk above the city's general homicide rate; the police department's own framing is corroborating qualitative evidence, dated 2023.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport and executive-order challenges unresolved; no documented remedy for travelers already stranded; four units rated 'Do Not Travel' for trans people (July 2026); 2026 legislative season described as degrading; division litigation outcome and hospital-surgery suspension permanence unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Multiple orders blocked/enjoined; national employment non-discrimination and hate-crime law; 22 units plus capital district bar gender-identity discrimination; running legal-aid FAQ.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Functioning courts mitigate partially, but the liability clause applies: hostile federal and division rules are enforced by efficient institutions, so injunctions that have not issued do not offset operative practices.

anchor_checks.comparison: 0.25-C features birth-sex prison placement plus cross-dressing criminalised in administrative buildings and periodic raids. This dossier lacks expression criminalisation and general raids, and retains active judicial remedies and protective units, so it sits above 0.25-C; but its universal document regime and custody conversion-therapy policy keep it well below the mid-scale anchors.

0.45-A shows routine biometric checkpoint exposure, a deceptive-presentation statute, lengthy detentions with scarce legal aid. This dossier matches that universal document exposure but adds a criminal facility provision in four units, a division care ban with licence revocation, and documented hostile custody practices — pushing it slightly below 0.45, offset partly by stronger litigation and hate-crime coverage.

0.55-B's harms are discretionary secondary screening and administrative refusal with appeal desks. This dossier's entry exposure is a formal, published policy with fraud-refusal and strandings, plus facilities, custody and care layers — materially harsher, so it scores well below 0.55-B.

0.75-C accepts mismatched/X markers, trains officers, and offers tribunal appeals with compensation. This dossier documents the opposite entry posture (markers barred, refusal ordered, travelers stranded) and hostile custody — categorically less safe, far below 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one system: a federal layer that makes document mismatch a near-universal exposure (marker regime, refusal cable, fraud-refusal threat, strandings) sitting on a state layer where facility exclusion is common and criminal in four units, and where the division bans minor care and lost adult surgical capacity. Outing at any stage — border, restroom, hospital, arrest — cascades into custody governed by a conversion-therapy-style inmate policy and documented immigration-detention abuse. Violence evidence is background-level and unusable for magnitude. Protections (hate-crime statute, employment ruling, 22 protective units, active injunctions, legal-aid guidance) are genuine but unequenforced against the operative hostile rules, so they cushion rather than cancel exposure.
